graph_semantics.recorded_agent_artifact: Evidence that Cursor recorded a message/call/result/file change.
graph_semantics.independent_observation: Not supplied by this Cursor artifact input; add Sysmon/Procmon/server/harness evidence separately.
graph_semantics.causality: No edge is causal by default; chronological proximity alone never creates an edge.

statistics.note: Cursor-owned artifacts are recorded evidence, not independent OS/server observations.

edges.basis: same session + exact response/prompt text hash
